newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Plane crashes in Zaire, at least four dead.
newsitem.headline: Plane crashes in Zaire, at least four dead.

text.p: At least four people were killed, including two Belgian crew, when a plane crashed in south western Zaire near the border with a diamond mining area of Angola, the company that owned the plane said on Friday.

Malu Aviation said that 15 people survived the crash, which occurred on Thursday shortly after the plane took off from Kahemba. It named the dead Belgian pilot and co-pilot as brothers Pierre and Willy Marion.
Airport sources in Kinshasa put the death toll at six and spoke of four survivors. The sources blamed technical problems.
Diamond traders are frequent passengers on flights to the area offered by a myriad of small companies.
